profiles.label: Reasoning over long documents
profiles.scope: Answering questions that require reasoning across long documents.
profiles.caveat: Performance on your own documents is unmeasured.
profiles.cost_title: Estimated API cost per 1,000 benchmark tasks

excluded.gemini-3-8-flash-low: Missing matched score or task-cost records: AA-LCR v1.1, GDP.pdf.

profiles.label: Reading & synthesizing research
profiles.scope: Connecting findings across papers, reports and long source material.
profiles.caveat: A reading-and-reasoning proxy; citation accuracy, coverage of the literature and original discoveries are unmeasured.
profiles.cost_title: Estimated API cost per 1,000 benchmark tasks

excluded.gemini-3-8-flash-low: Missing matched score or task-cost records: AA-LCR v1.1.

profiles.label: Advanced academic questions
profiles.scope: Answering closed-ended expert questions across academic subjects.
profiles.caveat: Multiple-choice and short-answer questions across subjects. This comparison does not measure proof writing, proof checking or mathematical research.
profiles.cost_title: Estimated API cost per 1,000 benchmark tasks
profiles.interpretation: HLE scores answer accuracy on academic questions. Proof writing, proof checking and research usefulness are unmeasured.

excluded.gemini-3-8-flash-low: Missing matched score or task-cost records: HLE.

profiles.label: Drafting video scripts
profiles.scope: Writing educational YouTube scripts in one creator’s voice from supplied briefs and research.
profiles.caveat: Ten briefs, five drafts each, judged against one creator’s scripts. This measures that writing style, not all prose. Two of the four judges, Claude Opus 5.5 and GPT-6.1 Sol, are also compared here.
profiles.cost_note: API-price estimates from recorded generation, not subscription charges. Free routes and estimated token prices are excluded.
profiles.settings_note: Only the source’s tested settings are offered.

profiles.label: German copy editing
profiles.scope: Proofreading, tightening and editorial feedback on German text.
profiles.caveat: Three German editing tasks, three trials each. The composite tests correction, fact preservation and editorial feedback; it is not an English editing benchmark.
profiles.source_label: hermes3000 Writing Benchmark, HybridAI GmbH · October 18, 2026
profiles.cost_title: Estimated API cost per 1,000 editing tasks
profiles.cost_note: Equal mix of proofreading, tightening and feedback. Costs cover generation only, using this run’s token prices.
profiles.settings_note: Provider default means the source did not set an effort; it is not mapped to Low, Medium or High.

profiles.label: Single-slide creation
profiles.scope: Creating one slide from a supplied layout, content, visual reference and ASCII plan.
profiles.caveat: 139 tasks completed by all ten models, drawn from 150 tasks. Tests individual slides in Slidely’s harness, not full decks; failures are excluded.
profiles.cost_note: Mean billed credits converted to USD. Only tested models are compared; relative Arena ratings are not averaged into mixtures.
profiles.settings_note: All models used high reasoning with caching enabled in Slidely’s harness. API model IDs and fallback behavior are not reported.

profiles.label: Document questions & extraction
profiles.scope: Finding information and answering questions grounded in long documents.
profiles.caveat: Measures work grounded in source documents; it does not measure prose editing, slide generation or every document workflow.
